column1: # The fuzz failures that are known (VARKA-277; VarkaKnownFailures).
# Tab separated: lane (int, long, byte or short for the IR fuzzer; projection, predicate, wide
# or forced for the composition fuzzer), seed, iteration, signature kind, signature text, reason.
# A fuzzer's failure with a listed signature does not fail the run; a listed entry that its
# lane, seed and iteration no longer reproduce fails as stale, so the list only shrinks.
# The reason names the plan row or ticket that owns the bug. At the master that added this file
# no fuzzer fails, so it holds no entries.
